name: Little Lifeline
subtitle: Build your little clinic
promotionalText: New in 4.2: twenty pieces of equipment in every room, ten versions each. Upgrade from basic to advanced and watch your clinic grow.
description:
Your first patient is at reception. Collect their payment, hire a nurse and give your little clinic its first success.

Little Lifeline is a miniature 3D clinic management game. Watch people check in, wait, receive care and find their way home. Use the money they leave at reception to improve the next visit.

START SMALL
Begin with one reception desk and one first-aid room, plus 250 coins and 5 gems to get going. Your first payment hires the first nurse. As more patients arrive, choose when to add staff, another treatment station and a comfortable waiting room.

FOLLOW THE WHOLE VISIT
Queues form inside the reception, and seats and moving patients show where your clinic needs help. Tap the cash at each counter and watch coins fly to your wallet. Build a car park where drivers pay at the barrier on the way out, add toilets and vending, and watch patients walk back to their cars and drive away.

IMPROVE WHAT MATTERS
Train individual staff members and upgrade each desk and treatment station. Every room has twenty pieces of equipment that arrive as you renovate, and each piece has ten versions, from basic to advanced. Upgrade them to shorten check-ins, treatments and waits, add decorations, and renovate rooms to unlock more. Watch each room rebuild while existing services keep working. One builder works at a time; a second builder lets two rooms build at once.

OPEN A SECOND CLINIC
Fully upgrade the starter clinic and spend 100,000 earned coins to open the larger doctors clinic. Add private consultations, pharmacy dispensing and a taxi stand; pharmacy counters and taxis collect coins from patients too. Grow to four receptionists, four doctors, four nurses and two pharmacists. Travel between your clinics with a shared wallet and separate patients, facilities and counter cash.

GOALS, GEMS AND A HELPING HAND
A short guide shows your next best step and rewards you for learning each feature. Three fresh goals arrive every day, a login streak builds toward bigger rewards, and milestones pay out free gems as your clinic grows. Spend gems to finish a renovation now, top up your coins, double your collections for a while or let your staff earn for longer while you're away.

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME
Pan and pinch to explore the clinic and its neighbourhood. Hear an original score and little sounds of daily activity, with separate Music and Effects controls. Adjust haptics and Less motion in Settings.

Your staff keep earning for up to eight hours while you're away, until the tills are full. Come back to collect their earnings from reception and decide what to improve next.

Play without an account or advertisements. Optional gem packs and a second builder are available as in-app purchases; every room, upgrade and clinic can be earned by playing. The clinic simulation works offline. Little Lifeline is a fictional management game and does not provide medical advice.
whatsNew:
Little Lifeline 4.2 gives every room twenty pieces of equipment to unlock and upgrade.

• Twenty pieces in every room. Each renovation unlocks a new one, from a first aid kit to a portable scanner.
• Ten versions of every piece, from basic to advanced. Each upgrade shows in the room and takes time off the clinic's work.
• A bigger waiting room with clear doorways, and visitors now queue inside the reception.
• In the doctors clinic, pharmacy counters and taxis collect coins from patients too.
• New clinics start with 250 coins and 5 gems. The Facilities tab is gone: queue places, seats and visit fees now grow with your equipment.

Your clinic, coins and upgrades carry over, and nothing gets slower.
reviewNotes:
Little Lifeline 4.0 is a miniature 3D clinic management game. No account, password, external hardware or payment is needed, and the simulation works offline. The game is fictional and provides no medical advice.

What's new for review: in-app purchases. This version adds four consumable gem packs (com.flutterly.gravitile.gems.small, .medium, .large, .xl) and one non-consumable, the Second Builder (com.flutterly.gravitile.builder). All five are attached to this version.

How to find them:
1. Launch and wait for the first patient to pay at reception, then tap the cash marker to collect it.
2. Tap the gem counter next to the coin wallet at the top. This opens Gems & goals with three tabs: Today (daily goals and login streak), Goals (milestones) and Shop.
3. The Shop tab lists the four gem packs with App Store prices, then items bought with gems: coin top-ups, double collections for 1 or 4 hours, longer offline earnings, and the Second Builder, which can be bought with money or unlocked with 400 gems earned in play.
4. To see gems spent in play: tap a room, choose Renovate, then Finish beside the construction timer.

Gems are awarded free for milestones, daily goals and the login streak, so every item can be reached without paying. Every room, upgrade and clinic can also be earned with game coins alone. There are no random rewards, loot boxes, advertisements or subscriptions.

Purchases: a gem transaction is finished only after its gems are saved on the device, so an interrupted purchase is delivered on the next launch. Refunded purchases remove the unspent gems. Restore Purchases re-applies the Second Builder. Gems are consumable and stored on the device; the shop says so.

Existing players keep their saved clinic. Milestones they reached before updating can be collected as gems.
